acceptanceCriteria: A non-submitting workflow can record progress that noProgressRun counts, via one of the issue's three options, with the choice recorded in the spec.
With no declared signal, loopDetection behaviour is unchanged (existing tests pass).
The recorded progress is visible to ticket blockers and plan preview.
body: From GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1068 (opened 2026-10-17). loopDetection (CAL-V0-102) counts a generation with a clean HANDOFF, zero gate results, zero reviews and no new candidate tree as no progress; the only other signal is an obligation witness raise. Workflows that progress through branch commits, external test evidence or status files cannot enable loopDetection without every ticket being held. Ask (any one): an attempt-level progress marker (attempt progress --attempt A --generation G --evidence REF [--kind code|run|note]); or count a changed --evidence reference on the HANDOFF release as progress; or a policy-selected signal set (candidateTree, gateResults, reviews, evidence, obligationRaise). Default unchanged. Related: V1-1608 (#1050, adopter-declared progress signal); deliver in the same lane.
title: loopDetection: count attempt-level progress for workflows that do not submit candidate trees (issue #1068)
